description:
MFC Developer 
 

 On behalf of our client, Procom Services is searching for a MFC Developer for a contract opportunity in Hillsboro, OR. 
 

 MFC Developer Job Details 
 

 • Development and debugging of Windows based application using Microsoft Foundation Classes (MFC). 
 • Developing and debugging test firmware for Nordic based ARM SoC. 
 • Developing automated test cases for HW validation. 
 • Bug management. Regular bug fixes and release management. 
 • Documentation of test steps and procedures for manufacturing test. 
 

 MFC Developer Mandatory Skills 
 

     BS/MS in Computer Science or Computer Engineering 
     3-4 Experience writing code in C++ using Microsoft Foundation Classes (MFC). Worked with Visual Studio for writing basic GUI based application. 
     Have understanding about various build environments, tool chains. 
     Working knowledge of writing firmware for ARM based devices/SoCs. 
     Working knowledge of configuration management tools like Perforce, Git or Cleacase
 

 MFC Developer Start Date 
 

 ASAP
 

 MFC Developer Assignment Length 
 

 6 Months
 

 "Please note that we are not able to work with candidates on H1B Visas or candidates represented by third parties." 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Please send your resume in Word format only.
